parsed_json.up: Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL1336 to include parent and all salts. Join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on molregno, then docs on doc_id for pubmed_id_or_doi. Join activities on record_id, then assays on assay_id for assay_description.
